title: ChatGPT plugin and standards-compliant MCP integration specification

phases.objective: Prove that the specification inventory, contracts, Work Map posture, delivery boundaries, and no-secret guarantees are internally consistent without granting runtime, migration, deployment, submission, or publication authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec 016 manifest and executable validation tool
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives a deterministic pass only when all recorded artifacts exist, JSON contracts parse, the OpenAPI MCP surfaces are present, completion remains truthful, implementation stays blocked by owned gates, and no secret-like value is detected.
steps: Load the canonical Spec 016 manifest and verify its complete unique file inventory.
Parse every JSON contract and confirm the required OpenAPI MCP and protected-resource paths are declared.
Verify completion counts, in-progress state, no Production deployment, no publication, and no-secret boundaries.
Verify the Work Map has zero accidental unclassified objects while implementation readiness remains blocked pending canonical review.
Scan every specification artifact for bounded secret-like patterns and emit a no-secret validation result.
assertions: Every manifest entry exists inside the Spec 016 root and no path escapes that root.
The manifest and completion file counts are equal and include the executable validator.
The OpenAPI draft includes the MCP endpoint and OAuth protected-resource metadata endpoint.
The specification records implementation as in progress while deployment, publication, and migration remain false.
The validator cannot authorize implementation, merge, deployment, OAuth registration, external mutation, submission, or publication.

phases.objective: Complete approved OAuth, transport, context, catalog, and developer-mode implementation evidence in separately governed runtime PRs.
Prove isolation, revocation, dependency faults, unknown outcomes, metadata drift detection, and recovery without secret or cross-tenant leakage.
Validate the exact implementation candidate through MCP Inspector and ChatGPT Developer mode against an authorized non-production endpoint.
Verify exact Production SHA, public routing, OAuth linkage, metadata parity, monitoring, revocation, rollback, and post-merge evidence under separate release authorization.
